featuresSection.title: Key Capabilities
featuresSection.subtitle: Agentic AI capabilities powering predictive vehicle maintenance and intelligent decision-making

featuresList.title: Predictive Failure Detection
featuresList.description: Detect vehicle component failures before they occur using AI.
featuresList.expandedDescription: Isolation Forest–based anomaly detection continuously analyzes multi-sensor data such as engine temperature, RPM, vibration, and battery voltage to identify early signs of failure and reduce unplanned downtime.

featuresList.title: AI Digital Twin
featuresList.description: Every vehicle is mirrored by an intelligent digital twin.
featuresList.expandedDescription: Each vehicle has a continuously updating digital twin that simulates health, stress, and failure scenarios using live (simulated) telemetry data.

featuresList.title: Agentic AI Orchestration
featuresList.description: Autonomous AI agents collaborate to diagnose and act.
featuresList.expandedDescription: A Master Agent coordinates multiple worker agents for data analysis, diagnosis, customer engagement, scheduling, manufacturing feedback, and reporting using a multi-agent Autogen architecture.

featuresList.title: Autonomous Service Scheduling
featuresList.description: Proactively schedules vehicle service with minimal user input.
featuresList.expandedDescription: Once a fault is detected and confirmed, the Scheduling Agent automatically recommends and books the nearest available service slot through a mock service API.

featuresList.title: Manufacturing Feedback Loop
featuresList.description: Failure insights flow back to manufacturing teams.
featuresList.expandedDescription: Repeated fault patterns across vehicles are aggregated to generate RCA and CAPA insights, helping manufacturers improve design quality and long-term reliability.

featuresList.title: UEBA Security Monitoring
featuresList.description: Monitors AI behavior for security and compliance.
featuresList.expandedDescription: A dedicated UEBA agent continuously tracks all AI actions, flags anomalous behavior, and ensures secure and compliant autonomous decision-making.
